units.zh: 同光二年夏五月己亥，帝御文明殿，冊齊王張全義為太尉。
units.en: On jihai in summer of Tongguang 2 Cunxu invested Zhang Quanyi as Prince of Qi and Grand Commandant at Wenming Hall.
units.literal: Summer, fifth month, jihai, Tongguang year 2: the Emperor took Wenming Hall to invest Prince of Qi Zhang Quanyi as Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 禮畢，全義赴尚書省領事，左諫議大夫竇專不降階，為御史所劾，專援引舊典，宰相不能詰，寢而不行。
units.en: After the rite Quanyi took office at the Directorate; Dou Zhuan refused to step down and was impeached; citing precedent, he left the ministers unable to answer and the case died.
units.literal: When the rite was done Quanyi went to the Directorate to take up office; Left Remonstrance Councillor Dou Zhuan did not descend the steps, was impeached by the censorate, cited old precedent, and the chief ministers could not rebut it—the matter was shelved.

units.zh: 庚子，太常卿李燕卒。
units.en: On gengzi Li Yan, Director of Ceremonies, died.
units.literal: On gengzi Director of Ceremonies Li Yan died.

units.zh: 壬寅，以教坊使陳俊為景州刺史，內園使儲德源為憲州刺史，皆梁之伶人也。
units.en: On renyin Chen Jun of the Music Bureau became Jing prefect and Chu Deyuan of the Inner Gardens Xian prefect—both Liang actors.
units.literal: On renyin Chen Jun, commissioner of the Music Bureau, was made Jing prefect, and Chu Deyuan, commissioner of the Inner Gardens, Xian prefect—both were Liang actor-retainers.

units.zh: 初，帝平梁，俊與德源皆為寵伶周匝所薦，帝因許除郡，郭崇韜以為不可，伶官言之者眾，帝密召崇韜謂之曰：「予已許除郡，經年未行，我慚見二人，卿當屈意行之。」
units.en: When Cunxu conquered Liang, Zhou Zha had recommended Jun and Deyuan for posts; Cunxu had promised them commands but Guo Chongtao objected; many actors pressed the case; Cunxu secretly told Guo, "I promised them prefectures a year ago and am ashamed to face them—humor me."
units.literal: Earlier, when the Emperor had pacified Liang, Jun and Deyuan had both been recommended by his favored actor Zhou Zha; he had promised them prefectures; Guo Chongtao held it impossible, yet many actor-officials spoke for it; the Emperor secretly summoned Chongtao and said, "I already promised them prefectures and for a year have not acted—I am ashamed to face the two of them; you must bend your will and carry it out."

units.zh: 故有是命。
units.en: Hence these appointments.
units.literal: Hence this order.

units.zh: 甲辰，以兗州節度使李紹欽依前檢校太保、兗州節度使，進封開國侯；
units.en: On jiachen Li Shaoqin of Yanzhou kept his Grand Guardian and Yanzhou posts and was made Marquis Who Opens the State;
units.literal: On jiachen Yanzhou military commissioner Li Shaoqin remained acting Grand Guardian and Yanzhou commissioner and was advanced to Marquis Who Opens the State;

units.zh: 以邠州節度使韓恭依前檢校太保、邠州節度使，進封開國伯。
units.en: Han Gong of Binzhou kept his posts and was made Earl Who Opens the State.
units.literal: Binzhou military commissioner Han Gong remained acting Grand Guardian and Binzhou commissioner and was advanced to Earl Who Opens the State.

units.zh: 丙午，以福建節度使、閩王王審知依前檢校太師、守中書令、福建節度使。
units.en: On bingwu Wang Shenzhi of Min kept Grand Preceptor, Secretariat, and Fujian posts.
units.literal: On bingwu Fujian military commissioner and King of Min Wang Shenzhi remained acting Grand Preceptor, Defender of the Secretariat, and Fujian commissioner.

units.zh: 戊申，幸郭崇韜第。
units.en: On wushen Cunxu visited Guo Chongtao's home.
units.literal: On wushen the Emperor visited Guo Chongtao's residence.

units.zh: 己酉，詔天下收拆防城之具，不得修浚池隍。
units.en: On jiyou an edict ordered the realm to dismantle defensive gear and banned moat repairs.
units.literal: On jiyou an edict ordered all under heaven to collect and dismantle city-defense equipment and forbade repairing or dredging moats.

units.zh: 以西都留守、京兆尹張筠依前檢校太保，充西都留守。
units.en: Zhang Jun of the Western Capital kept Grand Guardian and stayed regent of the western capital.
units.literal: Western Capital regent and Jingzhao prefect Zhang Jun remained acting Grand Guardian and was confirmed as Western Capital regent.

units.zh: 甲寅，以滄州節度使李紹斌充東北面招討使，以兗州節度李紹欽為副招討使，以宣徽使李紹宏為招討都監，率大軍渡河而北，時幽州上言契丹將寇河朔故也。
units.en: On jiayin Li Shaobin of Cangzhou led a northern campaign with Li Shaoqin of Yanzhou as deputy and Li Shaohong as supervisor, crossing the river because Youzhou reported Khitan raids on Hebei.
units.literal: On jiayin Cangzhou military commissioner Li Shaobin was made northeastern campaign commander, Yanzhou commissioner Li Shaoqin deputy commander, and Bureau of Palace Affairs commissioner Li Shaohong campaign supervisor, leading a great army across the river northward—at that time Youzhou had reported that the Khitan would raid Hebei, hence this.

units.zh: 乙卯，潞州叛將楊立遣使健步奉表乞行赦宥，帝令樞密副使宋唐玉齎敕書招撫。
units.en: On yimao Yang Li of Luzhou sent a swift memorial asking pardon; Cunxu sent Song Tangyu with an edict to pacify him.
units.literal: On yimao Luzhou rebel commander Yang Li sent a fast courier with a memorial begging amnesty; the Emperor ordered Bureau of Military Affairs vice commissioner Song Tangyu to carry an edict to win him over.

units.zh: 幽州上言，契丹營於州東南。
units.en: Youzhou said the Khitan were camped southeast of the city.
units.literal: Youzhou reported that the Khitan were encamped southeast of the prefecture.

units.zh: 丙辰，渤海國王大諲撰遣使貢方物。
units.en: On bingchen King Da Yinzhuan of Bohai sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: On bingchen the Great King of Bohai Da Yinzhuan sent envoys with regional tribute.

units.zh: 以澶州刺史李審益為幽州行軍司馬、蕃漢內外都知兵馬使。
units.en: Li Shenyi of Chanzhou was made Youzhou campaign marshal overseeing all Han and foreign troops.
units.literal: Chanzhou prefect Li Shenyi was made Youzhou campaign marshal and overseer of Han and non-Han forces within and without.

units.zh: 辛酉，故澤潞節度使丁會贈太師。
units.en: On xinyou the late Ding Hui of Ze-Lu was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: On xinyou the late Ze-Lu military commissioner Ding Hui was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 詔割復州為荊南屬郡。
units.en: Fuzhou was transferred to Jingnan circuit.
units.literal: An edict detached Fuzhou as a subordinate prefecture of Jingnan.

units.zh: 壬戌，以權知鳳翔軍府事、涇州節度使李嚴為起復雲麾將軍、右金吾大將軍同正，依前檢校太尉、兼中書令，充鳳翔節度使。
units.en: On renxu Li Yan of Fengxiang was restored to office as Cloud-Banner and Golden Brightness general while keeping Grand Commandant, Secretariat, and Fengxiang posts.
units.literal: On renxu acting Fengxiang commander and Jingzhou military commissioner Li Yan was made restored Cloud-Banner general and Right Golden Brightness general with concurrent nominal rank, remaining acting Grand Commandant and Secretariat vice director, and confirmed as Fengxiang commissioner.

units.zh: 乙丑，以權知歸義軍留後曹義金為歸義軍節度使、沙州刺史、檢校司空。
units.en: On yichou Cao Yijin was made Guiyi commissioner and Shazhou prefect with acting Minister of Works rank.
units.literal: On yichou acting Guiyi Army regent Cao Yijin was made Guiyi military commissioner, Shazhou prefect, and acting Minister of Works.

units.zh: 丙寅，李嗣源奏收復潞州。
units.en: On bingyin Li Siyuan reported Luzhou retaken.
units.literal: On bingyin Li Siyuan memorialized that Luzhou had been recovered.

units.zh: 幽州上言，新授宣武軍節度使李存審卒。
units.en: Youzhou said Li Cunshen, newly named Xuanwu commissioner, had died.
units.literal: Youzhou reported that the newly appointed Xuanwu military commissioner Li Cunshen had died.

units.zh: 六月甲戌，中書侍郎兼吏部尚書、平章事、宏文館大學士豆盧革加右僕射，餘如故；
units.en: In the sixth month, on jiaxu Dou Luge gained Right Vice Director while keeping chief minister and Hongwen posts;
units.literal: Sixth month, jiaxu: Secretariat vice director concurrent Minister of Personnel, chief minister, and Hongwen Academy university scholar Dou Luge was made Right Vice Director, with the rest as before;

units.zh: 侍中、監修國史、兼樞密使、鎮州節度使郭崇韜進爵邑，加功臣號；
units.en: Guo Chongtao, Palace Attendant, chief editor of state history, concurrently commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and military governor of Zhen Prefecture, advanced in noble rank and fief and received a merit title;
units.literal: Palace Attendant, chief editor of state history, concurrent Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner and Zhenzhou military commissioner Guo Chongtao advanced in noble rank and fief and received a merit title;

units.zh: 中書侍郎、平章事、集賢殿大學士趙光裔加兼戶部尚書；
units.en: Zhao Guangyi also became Minister of Revenue;
units.literal: Secretariat vice director, chief minister, and Hall of Assembled Worthies university scholar Zhao Guangyi was made concurrent Minister of Revenue;

units.zh: 禮部侍郎、平章事韋說加中書侍郎。
units.en: Wei Yue became Secretariat vice director.
units.literal: Vice Minister of Rites and chief minister Wei Yue was made Secretariat vice director.

units.zh: 宋州奏，節度使李紹安卒。
units.en: Songzhou said commissioner Li Shao'an had died.
units.literal: Songzhou reported that military commissioner Li Shao'an had died.

units.zh: 丙子，李嗣源遣使部送潞州叛將楊立等到闕，並磔於市。
units.en: On bingzi Li Siyuan sent Yang Li and the Luzhou rebels to court; all were torn apart in the market.
units.literal: On bingzi Li Siyuan sent envoys escorting Luzhou rebel Yang Li and others to court, and they were all torn apart at the market.

units.zh: 潞州城峻而隍深，至是帝命剗平之，因詔諸方鎮撤防城之備焉。
units.en: Luzhou's high walls and deep moat were razed on Cunxu's order, and circuits were told to dismantle defenses.
units.literal: Luzhou's walls were high and its moat deep; now the Emperor ordered them leveled, and by edict the various circuits were to remove city defenses.

units.zh: 丁丑，有司上言：「洛陽已建宗廟，其北京太廟請停。」
units.en: On dingchou the rites office said Luoyang's temple was enough and the northern capital's temple should close.
units.literal: On dingchou the relevant office memorialized: "Luoyang already has an Imperial Temple; the northern capital's Grand Temple should be discontinued."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 甲申，以衛國夫人韓氏為淑妃，燕國夫人伊氏為德妃，仍令所司擇日冊命。
units.en: On jiashen Lady Han became Shufei and Lady Yi Defei, with days set for investiture.
units.literal: On jiashen Lady Han of Wei state was made Shufei, Lady Yi of Yan state Defei, and the relevant office was ordered to choose a day for full investiture.

units.zh: 故河東節度副使、守左諫議大夫李襲吉贈禮部尚書；
units.en: The late Li Xiji of Hedong was posthumously made Minister of Rites;
units.literal: The late Hedong deputy commissioner and Defender of the Left Remonstrance Li Xiji was posthumously made Minister of Rites;

units.zh: 故河東節度副使、禮部尚書蘇循贈左僕射；
units.en: the late Su Xun of Hedong Left Vice Director;
units.literal: the late Hedong deputy commissioner and Minister of Rites Su Xun was posthumously made Left Vice Director;

units.zh: 故河東觀察判官、檢校右僕射司馬揆贈司空；
units.en: the late Sima Kui of Hedong was posthumously made Minister of Works;
units.literal: the late Hedong observation judge and acting Right Vice Director Sima Kui was posthumously made Minister of Works;

units.zh: 故河東留守判官、工部尚書李敬義贈右僕射。
units.en: and Li Jingyi of Hedong Right Vice Director.
units.literal: the late Hedong regent judge and Minister of Works Li Jingyi was posthumously made Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 丙戌，以順義軍節度使李令錫為許州節度使，以前保義軍留後李紹真為徐州節度使，以徐州節度使李紹榮為宋州節度使。
units.en: On bingxu Li Lingxi took Xu, Li Shaozhen Xuzhou, and Li Shaorong Song.
units.literal: On bingxu Shunyi military commissioner Li Lingxi was made Xu military commissioner; former Baoyi regent Li Shaozhen was made Xuzhou military commissioner; and Xuzhou military commissioner Li Shaorong was made Song military commissioner.

units.zh: 戊子，汝州防禦使張繼孫賜死於本郡。
units.en: On wuzi Zhang Jisun of Ruzhou was ordered to die in his circuit.
units.literal: On wuzi Ruzhou defender Zhang Jisun was ordered to die in his own prefecture.

units.zh: 繼孫即齊王張全義之假子也，本姓郝氏，為兄繼業等訟其陰事，故誅之。
units.en: Jisun was Quanyi's adopted son, born Hao; his brother Jiye exposed secret crimes, so he was killed.
units.literal: Jisun was the adopted son of Prince of Qi Zhang Quanyi, originally surnamed Hao; his elder brother Jiye and others sued him for secret crimes, hence the execution.

units.zh: 〈（《冊府元龜》載：張繼業為河陽兩使留後。
units.en: (The 《Prime Tortoise of the Imperial Archives》 says Zhang Jiye was acting commissioner of the two Heyang commissions.
units.literal: (The 《Prime Tortoise of the Imperial Archives》 records: Zhang Jiye was regent of the two He-Yang commissions.

units.zh: 莊宗同光二年六月，繼業上疏稱：「弟繼孫，本姓郝，有母尚在，父全義養為假子，令管衙內兵士。
units.en: In Tongguang 2, sixth month, Jiye wrote, "My brother Jisun, born Hao, still has a mother; Quanyi adopted him and gave him the yamen guard.
units.literal: In the sixth month of Tongguang 2 Zhuangzong, Jiye memorialized: "My younger brother Jisun, originally surnamed Hao, still has a mother living; Father Quanyi raised him as an adopted son and put him in charge of the yamen guard.

units.zh: 自皇帝到京，繼孫私藏兵甲，招置部曲，欲圖不軌，兼私家淫縱，無別無義。
units.en: Since the court came to the capital he has hoarded arms, recruited men, and plotted rebellion, and indulged in lust without duty.
units.literal: Since the Emperor reached the capital Jisun has secretly stored arms and armor, recruited followers, and plotted rebellion; he also indulged in private lust without restraint or duty.

units.zh: 臣若不自陳，恐累家族。」
units.en: If I do not speak out I fear for the family."
units.literal: If I do not report myself I fear harm to the clan."

units.zh: 敕曰：「有善必賞，所以勸忠孝之方；
units.en: An edict read, "Good must be rewarded to encourage loyalty and filial piety;
units.literal: An edict said: "Good must be rewarded, to encourage the path of loyalty and filial piety;

units.zh: 有惡必誅，所以絕奸邪之跡。
units.en: evil must be punished to cut off treachery.
units.literal: evil must be punished, to cut off the traces of treachery.

units.zh: 其或罪狀騰於眾口，醜行布於近親，須舉朝章，冀明國法。
units.en: When crimes are public and kin are shamed, state law must clarify the case.
units.literal: When crimes are shouted by the multitude and foul conduct spreads among close kin, the court code must be invoked to clarify state law.

units.zh: 汝州防禦使張繼孫，本非張氏子孫，自小丐養，以至成立，備極顯榮，而不能酬撫育之恩，履謙恭之道，擅行威福，常恣奸凶，侵奪父權，惑亂家事，縱鳥獸之行，畜梟獍之心，有識者所不忍言，無賴者實為其黨。
units.en: Ruzhou defender Zhang Jisun, not a Zhang by birth but raised from a beggar child to glory, repaid kindness with arrogance, seized his father's power, confused the house, and behaved like beasts with an owl's heart—honest men were silenced and rogues were his gang.
units.literal: Ruzhou defender Zhang Jisun was not born of the Zhang clan; from childhood he was begged and raised to full standing, given the utmost glory, yet could not repay fostering kindness or walk the path of humility; he wielded power at will, constantly indulged wickedness, usurped his father's authority, and confused the household; he practiced the conduct of birds and beasts and harbored the heart of an owl—those with understanding could not bear to speak of it, and the lawless were his party.

units.zh: 而又橫征暴斂，虐法峻刑，藏兵器於私家，殺平人於廣陌。
units.en: He also taxed harshly, punished cruelly, hid arms at home, and killed people in the street.
units.literal: Moreover he levied harshly and punished cruelly, hid weapons in his home, and killed commoners in the open road.

units.zh: 罔思悛改，難議矜容，宜竄逐於遐方，仍歸還於姓氏，俾我勳賢之族，永除汙穢之風。
units.en: Unrepentant and unworthy of mercy, he should be exiled and his surname restored so meritorious families are rid of this stain.
units.literal: He gave no thought to reform and could not be shown mercy; he should be banished to a distant place and his surname restored, that our meritorious clans may forever be rid of this foul wind.

units.zh: 凡百臣僚，宜體朕命。
units.en: Let all officials heed this command.
units.literal: Let all officials embody my command.

units.zh: 可貶房州司戶參軍同正，兼勒復本姓。」
units.en: He is demoted to Fang registrar and must resume his original surname."
units.literal: He is demoted to acting registrar of Fang prefecture with concurrent restoration of his original surname."

units.zh: 尋賜自盡，仍籍沒資產。）〉
units.en: He was soon ordered to die and his goods were seized.)〉
units.literal: Soon he was ordered to take his own life and his property was confiscated.)〉

units.zh: 己丑，以回鶻可汗仁美為英義可汗。
units.en: On jichou Uyghur khagan Ren Mei was named Illustrious Righteous Khagan.
units.literal: On jichou the Uyghur khagan Ren Mei was made Illustrious Righteous Khagan.

units.zh: 詔改輝州為單州。
units.en: Hui prefecture was renamed Shan.
units.literal: An edict changed Hui prefecture to Shan prefecture.

units.zh: 庚寅，故左僕射裴樞，右僕射裴贄、崔遠並贈司徒；
units.en: On gengyin the late Pei Shu, Pei Zan, and Cui Yuan were posthumously made Grand Mentor;
units.literal: On gengyin the late Left Vice Director Pei Shu, Right Vice Director Pei Zan, and Cui Yuan were all posthumously made Grand Mentor;

units.zh: 故靜海軍節度使獨孤損贈司空；
units.en: Dugu Sun of Jinghai Minister of Works;
units.literal: the late Jinghai military commissioner Dugu Sun was posthumously made Minister of Works;

units.zh: 故吏部尚書陸扆贈右僕射；
units.en: Lu Yi of Personnel Right Vice Director;
units.literal: the late Minister of Personnel Lu Yi was posthumously made Right Vice Director;

units.zh: 故工部尚書王溥贈右僕射。
units.en: and Wang Pu of Works Right Vice Director.
units.literal: the late Minister of Works Wang Pu was posthumously made Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 裴樞等六人皆前朝宰輔，為梁祖所害於白馬驛，至是追贈焉。
units.en: All six had been Tang chief ministers killed by the Liang founder at Baima Post and were now posthumously honored.
units.literal: Pei Shu and the other six had all been chief ministers of the former dynasty and were killed by the Liang founder at Baima Post; now they were posthumously honored.

units.zh: 壬辰，以天平軍節度使、蕃漢總管副使、開府儀同三司、檢校太尉、兼中書令李嗣源為宣武軍節度使、蕃漢馬步總管，餘如故。
units.en: On renchen Li Siyuan of Tianping became Xuanwu commissioner and Han and non-Han chief while keeping his other posts.
units.literal: On renchen Tianping military commissioner, Han and non-Han deputy chief, Acting Grand Commandant, and Secretariat vice director Li Siyuan was made Xuanwu military commissioner and Han and non-Han horse-and-foot chief, with the rest as before.

units.zh: 甲午，以樞密使、特進、左領軍衛上將軍、知內侍省事張居翰為驃騎大將軍、守左驍衛上將軍，進封開國伯，賜功臣號。
units.en: On jiawu Zhang Juhan became Cavalry general-in-chief and Left Martial Tiger defender, was made Earl Who Opens the State, and received a merit title.
units.literal: On jiawu Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, Special Counselor, Left Leading Army general, and director of inner palace affairs Zhang Juhan was made Cavalry general-in-chief and Defender of the Left Martial Tiger general, advanced to Earl Who Opens the State, and granted a merit title.

units.zh: 秋七月戊戌朔，故宣武軍節度使李存審男彥超進其父牙兵八千七百人。
units.en: On the wuxu new moon of the seventh month Yanchao presented his late father Li Cunshen's guard of 8,700 men.
units.literal: Seventh month, wuxu new moon: the late Xuanyang military commissioner Li Cunshen's son Yanchao presented his father's personal guard of eight thousand seven hundred men.

units.zh: 己亥，中書門下奏：「每年南郊壇四祠祭，太微宮五薦獻，並宰臣攝太尉行事，惟太廟遣庶僚行事，此後太廟祠祭，亦望差宰臣行事。」
units.en: "On jihai the Secretariat asked that temple rites, like altar and Taiwei offerings, be performed by chief ministers rather than junior staff."
units.literal: On jihai the Secretariat memorialized: "Each year at the southern altar the four shrine offerings and at Taiwei Palace the five presentations are all performed by chief ministers acting as libationer; only the Imperial Temple sends junior officials—hereafter Imperial Temple offerings should also be assigned to chief ministers."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 乙巳，汴州雍丘縣大風，拔木傷稼。
units.en: On yisi Yongqiu in Bianzhou had a wind that uprooted trees and ruined crops.
units.literal: On yisi Yongqiu county in Bianzhou had a great wind that uprooted trees and damaged crops.

units.zh: 曹州大雨，平地水三尺。
units.en: Caozhou flooded three feet deep on level ground.
units.literal: Caozhou had heavy rain and three feet of water on level ground.

units.zh: 丙午，以襄州節度使孔為潞州節度使，李存霸為鄆州節度使。
units.en: On bingwu Kong Qing, military governor of Xiang Prefecture, was made military governor of Lu Prefecture, and Li Cunba was made military governor of Yun Prefecture.
units.literal: On bingwu Xiang military commissioner Kong was made Luzhou military commissioner, and Li Cunba was made Yun military commissioner.

units.zh: 乙酉，幸龍門之雷山，祭天神，從北俗之舊事也。
units.en: On yiyou Cunxu sacrificed at Thunder Mountain on Longmen, following a northern custom.
units.literal: On yiyou the Emperor went to Thunder Mountain at Longmen to sacrifice to Heaven—following the northern custom of old.

units.zh: 辛亥，以鄆州副使李紹珙為襄州留後，以前澤州刺史董璋為邠州留後。
units.en: On xinhai Li Shaogong became Xiang regent, and Dong Zhang became Binzhou regent.
units.literal: On xinhai Yan deputy commissioner Li Shaogong was made Xiang regent; former Ze prefect Dong Zhang was made Bin regent.

units.zh: 戊午，西川王衍遣偽署戶部侍郎歐陽彬來朝貢，稱「大蜀皇帝上書大唐皇帝」。
units.en: On wuwu Wang Yan of Shu sent Ouyang Bin as tribute envoy, signing as "Great Shu Emperor to Great Tang Emperor."
units.literal: On wuwu Shu ruler Wang Yan sent his false-appointed Vice Minister of Revenue Ouyang Bin to court with tribute, styling himself "Great Shu Emperor writing to the Great Tang Emperor."

units.zh: 庚申，以應州為雲州屬郡，升新州為威塞軍節度使，以媯、儒、武等州為屬郡。
units.en: On gengshen Ying was attached to Yun and Xin became Weisai commissioner over Ji, Ru, and Wu.
units.literal: On gengshen Ying prefecture was made a subordinate of Yun prefecture; Xin was raised to Weisai military commissioner with Ji, Ru, and Wu as subordinates.

units.zh: 壬戌，皇子繼岌妻王氏封魏國夫人。
units.en: On renxu Jiji's wife Lady Wang was made Lady of Wei state.
units.literal: On renxu the wife of Prince Jiji, Lady Wang, was enfeoffed as Lady of Wei state.

units.zh: 幽州奏，契丹安巴堅東攻渤海。
units.en: Youzhou said Khitan leader Ambagyan was attacking Bohai in the east.
units.literal: Youzhou reported that the Khitan Ambagyan was attacking Bohai eastward.

units.zh: 八月己巳，詔洛京應有隙地，任人請射修造，有主者限半年，令本主自修蓋，如過限不見屋宇，許他人占射。
units.en: In the eighth month, on jisi, vacant Luoyang land could be claimed for building; owners had half a year to build or others could take it.
units.literal: Eighth month, jisi: an edict said that vacant land in Luoyang might be claimed for building; where there was an owner, half a year was allowed for the owner to build—if after the limit no structure appeared, others might claim it.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》載此詔云：藩方侯伯，內外臣僚，於京邑之中，無安居之所，亦可請射，各自修營。）〉
units.en: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 adds that frontier lords and officials without capital homes could also claim and build.)〉
units.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 records this edict: frontier lords and inner and outer officials who had no dwelling in the capital might also claim sites and build for themselves.)〉

units.zh: 辛未，北京副留守、太原尹孟知祥加檢校太傅，增邑，賜功臣號。
units.en: On xinwei Meng Zhixiang of Taiyuan became acting Grand Mentor with added fief and a merit title.
units.literal: On xinwei Beijing deputy regent and Taiyuan prefect Meng Zhixiang was made acting Grand Mentor, with added fief and a merit title.

units.zh: 帝畋於西苑。
units.en: Cunxu hunted in the Western Park.
units.literal: The Emperor hunted in the Western Park.

units.zh: 癸酉，以租庸副使、守衛尉卿孔謙為租庸使，以右威衛上將軍孔循為租庸副使。
units.en: On guiyou Kong Qian became land-tax commissioner and Kong Xun his deputy.
units.literal: On guiyou land-tax vice commissioner and acting Director of the Imperial Guard Kong Qian was made land-tax commissioner, and Right Martial Tiger general Kong Xun was made land-tax vice commissioner.

units.zh: 甲戌，以權知汴州軍州事、翰林學士承旨、戶部尚書盧質為兵部尚書，依前翰林學士承旨，仍賜論思匡佐功臣。
units.en: On jiaxu Lu Zhi of Bian became Minister of War while keeping Hanlin chief and gaining the merit title Counsel in Reflection and Aid in Governance.
units.literal: On jiaxu acting Bian prefect, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief, and Minister of Revenue Lu Zhi was made Minister of War, remaining Hanlin Academician-in-Chief, and granted the merit title "Counsel in Reflection and Aid in Governance."

units.zh: 丙子，以雲州刺史、雁門以北都知兵馬使安元信為大同軍節度留後，以隰州刺史張廷裕為新州威塞軍節度留後。
units.en: On bingzi An Yuanxin of Yun became Datong regent and Zhang Tingyu of Yin Weisai regent.
units.literal: On bingzi Yun prefect and northern campaign overseer north of Yanmen An Yuanxin was made Datong military regent; Yin prefect Zhang Tingyu was made Weisai regent.

units.zh: 丁丑，樞密使郭崇韜上表請退，不允。
units.en: On dingchou Guo Chongtao asked to resign the bureau post; Cunxu refused.
units.literal: On dingchou Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Chongtao memorialized asking to retire; it was not granted.

units.zh: 戊寅，租庸使、守禮部尚書王正言罷使，守本官。
units.en: On wuyin Wang Zhengyan left the land-tax post but kept Minister of Rites.
units.literal: On wuyin land-tax commissioner and acting Minister of Rites Wang Zhengyan was removed from the commission and kept his original office.

units.zh: 辛巳，詔諸道節度、觀察、防禦、團練使、刺史，並於洛陽修宅一區。
units.en: On gengchen every commissioner and prefect was ordered to build a Luoyang residence.
units.literal: On gengchen an edict ordered every circuit military commissioner, observer, defender, training commissioner, and prefect to build one residence in Luoyang.

units.zh: 中書門下上言：「請今後諸道除節度副使、兩使判官外，其餘職員並諸州軍事判官，各任本處奏辟。」
units.en: "The Secretariat asked that except for deputies and two commission judges, all staff and military judges be hired locally."
units.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "Hereafter, except for deputy commissioners and the two commission judges, all other staff and military judges of the various prefectures should be recruited and memorialized by their own jurisdictions."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：同光二年八月八日，中書門下奏：「諸道除節度副使及兩使判官除授外，其餘職員並軍事判官，伏以翹車著詠，戔帛垂文，式重弓旌，以光尊俎。
units.en: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 on Tongguang 2, eighth month, eighth day: "Except for deputies and two commission judges appointed centrally, other staff and military judges—as the classics show, honored bows and banners dignify the feast.
units.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》: On the eighth day of the eighth month of Tongguang 2 the Secretariat memorialized: "Except for deputy commissioners and the two commission judges appointed by the court, all other staff and military judges—as the ode on the lofty carriage and the silk of the battle-axe show in writing, bow and banner are weighty to honor the feast.

units.zh: 由是副知已之薦，成接士之榮，必當備悉行藏，習知才行，允奉幕中之畫，以稱席上之珍。
units.en: Deputies should know their men's conduct and talent and serve as treasures in the tent.
units.literal: Hence the deputy knows his recommender's glory in receiving scholars; he must fully know conduct and ability and serve the plan in the tent as a treasure at the table.

units.zh: 爰自偽梁，頗乖斯義，皆從除授，以佐藩宣。
units.en: Under Liang this was lost and the center appointed everyone to the circuits.
units.literal: From the false Liang court this meaning was greatly lost—all were appointed by the center to assist the circuits.

units.zh: 因緣多事之秋，慮爽得人之選，將期推擇，式示更張。
units.en: In troubled times the court feared poor choices and sought reform.
units.literal: In a season of many affairs we fear missing the right men and wish to choose anew and show reform.

units.zh: 今後諸道，除節度副使、判官兩使除授外，其餘職員並諸州軍事判官等，並任本道本州，各當辟舉，其軍事判官，仍不在奏官之限。」）〉
units.en: Henceforth circuits and prefectures should hire their own staff and military judges except for deputies and two commission judges; military judges need not be memorialized centrally."〉
units.literal: Hereafter, except for deputy commissioners and the two commission judges appointed by the court, all other staff and military judges of circuits and prefectures should be recruited by their own circuit or prefecture; military judges are still outside the limit of court memorials."〉

units.zh: 汴州奏，大水損稼。
units.en: Bianzhou reported flood damage to crops.
units.literal: Bianzhou reported that floodwaters had damaged crops.

units.zh: 癸未，租庸使孔謙進封會稽縣男，仍賜豐財贍國功臣。
units.en: On guiwei Kong Qian became Baron of Kuaiji with the merit title Enriching the State with Wealth.
units.literal: On guiwei land-tax commissioner Kong Qian was advanced to Baron of Kuaiji and granted the merit title "Enriching the State with Wealth."

units.zh: 淮南楊溥遣使貢方物。
units.en: Yang Pu of Huainan sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: Huainan's Yang Pu sent envoys with regional tribute.

units.zh: 宋州大水，鄆、曹等州大風雨，損稼。
units.en: Songzhou flooded; Yan and Cao had storms that ruined crops.
units.literal: Songzhou had great floods; Yan and Cao had great wind and rain that damaged crops.

units.zh: 丁亥，中書門下侍郎奏：「請差左丞崔沂、吏部侍郎崔貽孫、給事中鄭韜光、李光序、吏部員外郎盧損等，同詳定選司長定格、循資格、十道圖。」
units.en: On dinghai the Secretariat asked Cui Yi, Cui Yisun, Zheng Taoguang, Li Guangxu, and Lu Sun to review the Selection Bureau regulations, seniority rules, and Ten-Circuit Chart."
units.literal: On dinghai the Secretariat vice directors memorialized: "Please assign Left Vice Director Cui Yi, Vice Minister of Personnel Cui Yisun, Presentation Drafters Zheng Taoguang and Li Guangxu, and Personnel Vice Director Lu Sun, together to review in detail the Selection Bureau's long-form regulations, seniority rules, and Ten-Circuit Chart."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：同光二年八月，中書門下奏：「吏部三銓、門下省、南曹、廢置、甲庫、格式、流外銓等司公事，並係長定格、循資格、十道圖等，前件格文，本朝創立，檢製奸濫，倫敘官資頗謂精詳，久同遵守。
units.en: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutes》 says in the eighth month of Tongguang 2 the Secretariat reported, "Personnel's three boards, the Secretariat Gate, the Southern Office, appointments and dismissals, the roster office, formats, and external selection all rest on standing rules, sequential qualifications, and the Ten Circuits chart—rules this dynasty made to curb fraud and order rank, long and precisely observed.
units.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutes》: In the eighth month of Tongguang 2 the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "The regular business of the three selection boards of Personnel, the Secretariat Gate, the Southern Office, appointments and dismissals, the roster office, formats, and the external-selection office all concern the standing rules, sequential qualifications, and Ten Circuits chart; the foregoing regulations were created by this dynasty to check fraud and ordering official rank has been considered quite precise, long observed alike.

units.zh: 自亂離之後，巧偽滋多，兼同光元年八月，車駕在東京，權判工部員外郎盧重《本司起請》一卷，並以興復之始，務切懷來，凡有條流，多失根本，以至冬集赴選人，並南郊行事官，及陪位宗子共一千三百餘人，銓曹檢勘之時，互有援引，去留之際，不絕爭論，若又依違，必長訛濫。
units.en: After the chaos fraud spread; in Tongguang 1, eighth month, at the Eastern Capital acting Works vice director Lu Chong filed a 《Petition from This Office》 roll—in restoration's first rush to win hearts many rules lost their root—so at the winter assembly candidates, southern-suburb officers, and attending imperial clansmen topped thirteen hundred; the selection office found endless precedent-citing and quarrels over who stayed; lax enforcement would only deepen abuse.
units.literal: Since the turmoil fraud has multiplied; moreover in the eighth month of Tongguang 1, when the imperial carriage was at the Eastern Capital, acting Vice Director of Works Lu Chong submitted one roll of 《Petition from This Office》, all because at the start of restoration they sought to win people over—wherever there were articles many lost their root—until at the winter assembly those coming for selection, officers for the southern suburb rites, and attending imperial clansmen together exceeded thirteen hundred; when the selection office examined them each cited precedents, and at the decision on who stayed or went disputes never ceased—if again followed loosely, abuse would surely grow.

units.zh: 望差權判尚書省銓左丞崔沂、吏部侍郎崔貽孫、給事中鄭韜光、李光序、吏部員外郎盧損等，同詳定舊長定格、循資格、十道圖，務令簡要，可久施行。」
units.en: We ask Acting Secretariat selection director Cui Yi, Personnel vice minister Cui Yisun, attendants-in-ordinary Zheng Taoguang and Li Guangxu, and Personnel vice director Lu Sun jointly to revise the standing rules, sequential qualifications, and Ten Circuits chart into something brief and lasting."
units.literal: We ask that Acting Left Director of the Secretariat selection office Cui Yi, Vice Minister of Personnel Cui Yisun, Attendants-in-ordinary Zheng Taoguang and Li Guangxu, and Personnel Vice Director Lu Sun be assigned together to review the old standing rules, sequential qualifications, and Ten Circuits chart, making them concise and workable for long implementation."

units.zh: 從之。）〉
units.en: The request was granted.)〉
units.literal: It was followed.)〉

units.zh: 癸巳，放朝參三日，以霖雨故也。
units.en: On guisi court was canceled three days for heavy rain.
units.literal: On guisi, court attendance was suspended for three days because of continuous rain.

units.zh: 陝州奏，河水溢岸。
units.en: Shaanxi reported the Yellow River over its banks.
units.literal: Shaanxi prefecture memorialized that the Yellow River overflowed its banks.

units.zh: 乙未，中書門下上言：「諸陵台令丞請停，以本縣令知陵台事。」
units.en: On yiwei the Secretariat asked to abolish tomb directors and vice directors and let each county magistrate oversee the tombs."
units.literal: On yiwei, the Secretariat and Chancellery submitted: "The directors and vice directors of the imperial tombs should be abolished; let the magistrate of the local county administer tomb affairs."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The throne approved.
units.literal: It was followed.

units.zh: 九月癸卯，畋於西北郊。
units.en: In the ninth month on guimao Cunxu hunted northwest of the city.
units.literal: In the ninth month on guimao, the Emperor hunted in the northwest suburb.

units.zh: 幽州上言，契丹安巴堅自渤海國回軍。
units.en: Youzhou said the Khitan Anbajian was marching back from Bohai.
units.literal: Youzhou reported that the Khitan Anbajian had returned his army from the Bohai state.

units.zh: 內園新殿成，名曰長春殿。
units.en: The inner garden's new hall was finished and named Everlasting Spring Hall.
units.literal: The inner garden's new hall was completed and named Everlasting Spring Hall.

units.zh: 戊申，以中書舍人、權知貢舉裴皞為禮部侍郎，以前鄭州防禦副使薑宏道為太僕卿。
units.en: On wushen Pei Hao—Secretariat drafter and acting examination director—became vice minister of rites, and former Zhengzhou defense vice commissioner Jiang Hongdao became minister of the imperial stud.
units.literal: On wushen, Secretariat drafter and acting director of the examinations Pei Hao was made Vice Minister of Rites; former Zhengzhou defense vice commissioner Jiang Hongdao was made Minister of the Imperial Stud.

units.zh: 侍中郭崇韜奏：「應三銓注授官員等，內有自無出身入仕，買覓鬼名告敕；
units.en: Guo Chongtao reported, "Among three-board appointees some had no pedigree and bought ghost-name patents;
units.literal: Chief minister Guo Chongtao memorialized: "Among officers appointed through the three selection boards, some entered office without any pedigree and bought ghost-name patents;

units.zh: 今將骨肉文書，揩改姓名；
units.en: now they alter kinship papers and names;
units.literal: now they erase and alter names on kinship documents;

units.zh: 或曆任不足，妄稱失墜；
units.en: or claim lost records when tenure falls short;
units.literal: or their service records fall short yet they falsely claim loss;

units.zh: 或假人蔭緒，托形勢論屬，安排參選，所司隨例注官。
units.en: or borrow another's lineage and pull strings to enter selection and win routine appointment.
units.literal: or borrow another's lineage and plead powerful connections to arrange candidacy, and the office routinely assigns posts.

units.zh: 如有人陳告，特議超獎；
units.en: Informants should win special reward;
units.literal: If someone denounces them, deliberate special reward;

units.zh: 其所犯人，檢格處分；
units.en: offenders checked and punished;
units.literal: the offenders are to be checked and punished;

units.zh: 若同保人內有偽濫者，並當駁放。
units.en: and if any guarantor is fraudulent, the whole group is rejected.
units.literal: if any guarantor within the group is fraudulent, all are to be rejected and dismissed.

units.zh: 應有人身死之處，今後並須申報本州，於告身上批書身死月日分明付子孫。
units.en: After any death the home prefecture must record month and day on the patent for heirs.
units.literal: Wherever a person has died, hereafter the native prefecture must be notified and the month and day of death clearly entered on the patent and handed to descendants.

units.zh: 今後銓司公事，至春末並須了畢。」
units.en: Selection business must finish by late spring."
units.literal: Hereafter selection-office business must all be finished by the end of spring."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The edict was approved.
units.literal: It was followed.

units.zh: 銓綜之司，偽濫日久，及崇韜條奏之後，澄汰甚嚴，放棄者十有七八，眾情亦怨之。
units.en: The selection office had long been corrupt; after Chongtao's rules the purge was fierce and seven or eight in ten were cast aside, to public resentment.
units.literal: The selection office had long been rife with fraud; after Chongtao's memorial the purge was very strict and seven or eight in ten were cast out—the crowd also resented it.

units.zh: 己酉，司天台請禁私曆日，從之。
units.en: On jiyou Astronomy asked to ban private calendars; the court agreed.
units.literal: On jiyou, the Directorate of Astronomy asked to ban private calendars; it was followed.

units.zh: 庚戌，有司自契丹至者，言女真、回鶻、黃頭室韋合勢侵契丹。
units.en: On gengxu a man back from the Khitan said Jurchen, Uyghur, and Yellow-head Shive had allied against them.
units.literal: On gengxu, an envoy returned from the Khitan saying the Jurchen, Uyghurs, and Yellow-head Shive had joined forces to invade the Khitan.

units.zh: 壬子，有司上言：「八月二十二日夜，熒惑犯星二度，星周分也，請依法禳之。
units.en: On renzi the rites offices said, "On the twenty-second night of the eighth month Mars crossed two degrees of Star—Zhou's asterism—so we ask lawful exorcism.
units.literal: On renzi, the responsible offices submitted: "On the night of the twenty-second day of the eighth month Mars trespassed two degrees of the Star constellation—the Star is Zhou's asterism—we ask to perform exorcism by law.

units.zh: 於京城四門懸東流水一罌，兼令都市嚴備盜火，止絕夜行。」
units.en: Hang east-flowing water at the four gates, tighten the markets against fire and theft, and forbid night travel."
units.literal: At the capital's four gates hang one jar of east-flowing water; and order the markets strictly to guard against theft and fire and stop night travel."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The court agreed.
units.literal: It was followed.

units.zh: 甲寅，幸郭崇韜第，置酒作樂。
units.en: On jiayin Cunxu visited Guo Chongtao's house for wine and music.
units.literal: On jiayin, the Emperor visited Guo Chongtao's residence and set out wine and music.

units.zh: 乙卯，以前振武節度使、安北都護馬存可依前檢校太尉、兼侍中，充寧遠軍節度、容管觀察使。
units.en: On yimao Ma Cun—former Zhenwu commissioner and Protector-General of the Pacified North—kept acting Grand Commandant and chief minister and became Ningyuan commissioner and Rongguan observer.
units.literal: On yimao, former Zhenwu military commissioner and Protector-General of the Pacified North Ma Cun could remain acting Grand Commandant and concurrent chief minister, and was made Ningyuan army military commissioner and Rongguan observation commissioner.

units.zh: 存，湖南馬殷之弟也。
units.en: Ma Cun was Ma Yin of Hunan's younger brother.
units.literal: Cun was the younger brother of Hunan's Ma Yin.

units.zh: 丙辰，黑水國遣使朝貢。
units.en: On bingchen Heishui sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: On bingchen, the Heishui state sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 契丹寇幽州。
units.en: The Khitan raided Youzhou.
units.literal: The Khitan raided Youzhou.

units.zh: 戊午，宣宰臣於中書，磨勘吏部選人，謬濫者焚毀告敕。
units.en: On wuwu the chancellors were sent to the Secretariat to audit Personnel candidates and burn fraudulent patents.
units.literal: On wuwu, the chancellors were ordered to the Secretariat to review Personnel candidates; the fraudulent had their patents burned.

units.zh: 冬十月戊辰，帝畋於西北郊。
units.en: In the tenth month on wuchen Cunxu hunted northwest of the city.
units.literal: In the tenth month on wuchen, the Emperor hunted in the northwest suburb.

units.zh: 己巳，故安義節度使、贈太尉、隴西郡王李嗣昭贈太師。
units.en: On jisi the late Anyi commissioner Li Sizhao—posthumous Grand Commandant and Prince of Longxi—was raised to Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: On jisi, the late Anyi military commissioner, posthumously made Grand Commandant and Prince of Longxi Li Sizhao was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 庚午，正衙命使冊淑妃韓氏、德妃伊氏，以宰臣豆盧革、韋說充冊使。
units.en: On gengwu at the main court envoys invested Pure Consort Han and Virtuous Consort Yi, with Dou Luge and Wei Shuo as investiture commissioners.
units.literal: On gengwu, at the main court envoys were ordered to invest Pure Consort Han and Virtuous Consort Yi; chief ministers Dou Luge and Wei Shuo served as investiture envoys.

units.zh: 辛未，詔：「今後支郡公事，須申本道騰狀奏聞。
units.en: On xinwei an edict said, "Hereafter sub-prefecture business must go up by circuit memorial.
units.literal: On xinwei, an edict: "Hereafter sub-prefecture business must be reported by memorial through the circuit.

units.zh: 租庸使各有征催祇牒，觀察使貴全理體。」
units.en: Rent-and-corvée commissioners each issue collection warrants, yet observers prize keeping the circuit whole."
units.literal: Each rent-and-corvée commissioner has his own collection warrant, yet the observation commissioner prizes preserving overall order."

units.zh: 契丹寇易、定北鄙。
units.en: The Khitan struck Yi and Ding's northern marches.
units.literal: The Khitan raided the northern border of Yi and Ding.

units.zh: 壬申，故大同軍防禦使李存璋贈太尉。
units.en: On renshen the late Datong defense commissioner Li Cunzhang was posthumously made Grand Commandant.
units.literal: On renshen, the late Datong defense commissioner Li Cunzhang was posthumously made Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 鄆州奏，清河泛溢，壞廬舍。
units.en: Yan reported the Qing River flooded and wrecked houses.
units.literal: Yan prefecture memorialized that the Qing River overflowed and destroyed houses.

units.zh: 癸未，畋於石橋。
units.en: On guiwei Cunxu hunted at Shiqiao.
units.literal: On guiwei, the Emperor hunted at Shiqiao.

units.zh: 甲戌，河南尹張全義上言：「萬壽節日，請於嵩山開琉璃戒壇，度僧百人。」
units.en: On jiaxu Henan prefect Zhang Quanyi asked to open a glazed ordination terrace on Mount Song at the Longevity Festival and ordain a hundred monks."
units.literal: On jiaxu, Henan prefect Zhang Quanyi submitted: "On the Longevity Festival, I ask to open a glazed ordination platform on Mount Song and ordain a hundred monks."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The throne approved.
units.literal: It was followed.

units.zh: 乙亥，故守太師、尚書令、秦王李茂貞追封秦王，賜諡曰忠敬。
units.en: On yihai Li Maozhen—late Guardian Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, and Prince of Qin—was posthumously made Prince of Qin with the posthumous title Loyal and Respectful.
units.literal: On yihai, the late Guardian Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Qin Li Maozhen was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Qin and given the posthumous title Loyal and Respectful.

units.zh: 丁丑，皇后差使賜兗州節度使李紹欽湯藥。
units.en: On dingchou the empress sent envoys with medicinal broth to Li Shaoqin of Yanzhou.
units.literal: On dingchou, the empress sent envoys to bestow medicinal broth on Yanzhou military commissioner Li Shaoqin.

units.zh: 時皇太后行誥命，皇后劉氏行教命，互遣使人宣達藩後，紊亂之弊，人不敢言。
units.en: Then the empress dowager issued edicts and Empress Liu teaching orders, each sending envoys to the frontier—a muddle no one dared name.
units.literal: At that time the empress dowager issued edicts and Empress Liu issued teaching orders; each sent envoys to announce them to the frontier—confusion from the practice, yet none dared speak.

units.zh: 己卯，汴、鄆二州奏，大水。
units.en: On jimao Bian and Yan reported great floods.
units.literal: On jimao, Bian and Yan prefectures memorialized great floods.

units.zh: 庚辰，以前太僕卿楊遘為大理卿。
units.en: On gengchen Yang Gou, former minister of the imperial stud, became director of judicial review.
units.literal: On gengchen, former Minister of the Imperial Stud Yang Gou was made director of the Court of Judicial Review.

units.zh: 党項進白驢，奚王李紹威進駝馬。
units.en: The Tangut sent a white donkey; Xi king Li Shaowei sent camels and horses.
units.literal: The Tangut presented a white donkey; the Xi king Li Shaowei presented camels and horses.

units.zh: 幽州奏，契丹入寇，至近郊。
units.en: Youzhou said the Khitan had reached the near suburbs.
units.literal: Youzhou memorialized that the Khitan had invaded as far as the near suburbs.

units.zh: 辛巳，故天雄軍節度副使王緘贈司空。
units.en: On xinsi the late Tianxiong vice commissioner Wang Jian was posthumously made acting Sikong.
units.literal: On xinsi, the late Tianxiong army vice commissioner Wang Jian was posthumously made acting Sikong.

units.zh: 壬午，以天下兵馬都元帥、尚父、守尚書令、吳越國王錢鏐可依前天下兵馬都元帥、尚父、守尚書令，封吳越國王。
units.en: On renwu Qian Liu—marshal-in-chief, imperial father, guardian director—kept marshal-in-chief, imperial father, and director posts and was confirmed King of Wuyue.
units.literal: On renwu, All-Army Marshal-in-Chief, Imperial Father, Guardian Director of the Secretariat, and King of Wuyue Qian Liu could remain All-Army Marshal-in-Chief, Imperial Father, and Guardian Director of the Secretariat, and was enfeoffed King of Wuyue.

units.zh: 癸未，幸小馬坊閱馬。
units.en: On guiwei Cunxu reviewed horses at the small paddock.
units.literal: On guiwei, the Emperor visited the small horse paddock to review horses.

units.zh: 甲申，以兩浙兵馬留後、清海軍節度、嶺南東道觀察等使、守太尉、兼侍中、廣州刺史錢元尞為檢校太師、兼中書令，充兩浙節度觀察留後，餘如故；
units.en: On jiashen Qian Yuanguan of Liangzhe—Qinghai commissioner, Lingnan East observer, acting Grand Commandant, chief minister, Guangzhou prefect—became acting Grand Preceptor and Secretariat director and Liangzhe retention commissioner, keeping the rest;
units.literal: On jiashen, Liangzhe army retention commissioner, Qinghai army military commissioner, Lingnan East Circuit observation commissioner, acting Grand Commandant, concurrent chief minister, and Guangzhou prefect Qian Yuanguan was made acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and made Liangzhe circuit observation retention commissioner, the rest unchanged;

units.zh: 以鎮東軍節度副大使、江南管內都招討使、建武軍節度、嶺南西道觀察等使、檢校太傅、守侍中、知蘇州中吳軍軍州事、行邕州刺史錢元尞為檢校太尉、兼中書令，餘如故。
units.en: Qian Yuanliao of Zhendong—Jiangnan overall commander, Jianwu commissioner, Lingnan West observer, acting Grand Tutor, acting chief minister, acting Suzhou prefect—became acting Grand Commandant and Secretariat director, keeping the rest.
units.literal: Zhendong army vice ambassador, overall commander within Jiangnan, Jianwu army military commissioner, Lingnan West Circuit observation commissioner, acting Grand Tutor, acting chief minister, acting Suzhou Zhongwu army prefect Qian Yuanliao was made acting Grand Commandant and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, the rest unchanged.

units.zh: 辛卯，天平軍監軍使柴重厚可特進、右領衛將軍同正，充鳳翔監軍使。
units.en: On xinmao Chai Chonghou of Tianping was specially advanced to Right Guard general of the same rank and made Fengxiang supervisory commissioner.
units.literal: On xinmao, Tianping army supervisory commissioner Chai Chonghou could be specially advanced and made Right Imperial Guard general of the same rank, and made Fengxiang supervisory commissioner.

units.zh: 甲午，以宣武軍節度押牙李從溫、李從璋、李從榮、李從厚、李從璨並銀青光祿大夫、檢校右散騎常侍兼御史大夫，宣武軍節度押牙李從臻可檢校國子祭酒兼御史中丞。
units.en: On jiawu Li Congwen, Li Congzhang, Li Congrong, Li Conghou, and Li Congcan—Xuanyi adjutants—became silver-blue-glow grandees and acting Right Regular Cavalier with censor-in-chief rank; Li Congzhen became acting National University libationer and vice censor-in-chief.
units.literal: On jiawu, Xuanyi army military commissioner's military adjutants Li Congwen, Li Congzhang, Li Congrong, Li Conghou, and Li Congcan were all made silver-blue-glow grandees, acting Right Regular Cavalier and concurrent Censor-in-chief; Xuanyi army military adjutant Li Congzhen could be made acting National University libationer and concurrent Vice Censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 自從溫而下，皆李嗣源諸子也。
units.en: From Congwen down they were all Li Siyuan's sons.
units.literal: From Congwen down, all were sons of Li Siyuan.

units.zh: 十一月丙申，靈武奏，甘州回鶻可汗仁美卒，其弟狄銀權主國事。
units.en: In the eleventh month on bingchen Lingwu reported Gansu Uyghur khan Renmei dead and his brother Doyin ruling provisionally.
units.literal: In the eleventh month on bingchen, Lingwu memorialized that Gansu Uyghur khan Renmei had died and his younger brother Doyin provisionally held state affairs.

units.zh: 吐渾白都督族帳移於代州東南。
units.en: Tuhun White-commander tribes moved southeast of Daizhou.
units.literal: The Tuhun White-commander tribal encampments moved southeast of Daizhou.

units.zh: 己亥，幸六宅宴諸弟。
units.en: On jihai Cunxu feasted his younger brothers at the Six Residences.
units.literal: On jihai, the Emperor visited the Six Residences to feast his younger brothers.

units.zh: 壬寅，尚書左丞、判吏部尚書銓事崔沂貶麟州司馬，吏部侍郎崔貽孫貶朔州司馬，給事中鄭韜光貶寧州司馬，吏部員外盧損貶府州司戶。
units.en: On renyin Cui Yi—Left Secretariat director and acting Personnel minister—was demoted to Linzhou aide; Cui Yisun to Shuozhou aide; Zheng Taoguang to Ningzhou aide; Lu Sun to Fuzhou registrar.
units.literal: On renyin, Left Secretariat Director and acting Personnel Minister Cui Yi was demoted to Linzhou aide; Vice Minister of Personnel Cui Yisun was demoted to Shuozhou aide; Attendant-in-ordinary Zheng Taoguang was demoted to Ningzhou aide; Personnel Vice Director Lu Sun was demoted to Fuzhou registrar.

units.zh: 時有選人吳延皓取亡叔告身故舊名求仕，事發，延皓付河南府處死，崔沂已下貶官。
units.en: Then candidate Wu Yanhao used his dead uncle's patent and old name to seek office; exposed, Yanhao was executed by Henan prefecture and Cui Yi and the rest were demoted.
units.literal: At that time the candidate Wu Yanhao took his dead uncle's patent and old name to seek office; when the matter broke out Yanhao was handed to Henan prefecture for execution, and Cui Yi and the rest were demoted.

units.zh: 宰相豆盧革、趙光裔、韋說詣閣門待罪，詔釋之。
units.en: Chancellors Dou Luge, Zhao Guangyi, and Wei Shuo waited at the Gate of Receiving Mandates for punishment; an edict pardoned them.
units.literal: Chancellors Dou Luge, Zhao Guangyi, and Wei Shuo went to the Gate of Receiving Mandates to await punishment; an edict released them.

units.zh: 癸卯，帝畋於伊闕，侍衛金槍馬萬餘騎從，帝一發中大鹿。
units.en: On guimao Cunxu hunted at Yique with more than ten thousand golden-lance guards and dropped a great stag at one shot.
units.literal: On guimao, the Emperor hunted at Yique; more than ten thousand golden-lance cavalry of the guard followed, and with one shot he struck a great stag.

units.zh: 是日，命從官拜梁祖之陵，物議非之。
units.en: That day he made followers bow at the Liang Founder's tomb—to public censure.
units.literal: That day he ordered his followers to bow at the Liang Founder's tomb; public opinion condemned it.

units.zh: 其夕，宿於張全義之別墅。
units.en: That night he stayed at Zhang Quanyi's villa.
units.literal: That evening he lodged at Zhang Quanyi's villa.

units.zh: 甲辰，宿伊闕縣。
units.en: On jiachen he lodged at Yique county.
units.literal: On jiachen, he lodged at Yique county.

units.zh: 乙巳，宿椹澗。
units.en: On yisi he lodged at Zhenjian.
units.literal: On yisi, he lodged at Zhenjian.

units.zh: 時騎士圍山，會夜，顛墜崖穀，死傷甚眾。
units.en: Horsemen had ringed the mountain; at night many fell into ravines, with heavy dead and wounded.
units.literal: At that time the horsemen ringed the mountain; when night came many tumbled into ravines, and dead and wounded were very numerous.

units.zh: 丙午，復命衛兵分獵，殺獲萬計。
units.en: On bingwu he again split the guard for a hunt that took tens of thousands.
units.literal: On bingwu, he again ordered guard troops to hunt separately; kills and captures numbered in the tens of thousands.

units.zh: 是夜，方歸京城，六街火炬如晝。
units.en: That night, returning to the capital, torches on the six streets blazed like noon.
units.literal: That night, just as he returned to the capital, torches on the six streets blazed like day.

units.zh: 丁未，賜群臣鹿肉有差。
units.en: On dingwei ministers received graded shares of venison.
units.literal: On dingwei, deer meat was bestowed on the ministers in graded shares.

units.zh: 庚戌，製改節將一十一人功臣號。
units.en: On gengxu an edict revised merit titles for eleven commissioners.
units.literal: On gengxu, an edict revised the merit titles of eleven military commissioners.

units.zh: 辛亥，以兵部侍郎李德休為吏部侍郎。
units.en: On xinhai Li Dexiu of War became Personnel vice minister.
units.literal: On xinhai, Vice Minister of War Li Dexiu was made Vice Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 壬子，日南至，百官拜表稱賀。
units.en: On renzi, the winter solstice, officials submitted congratulatory memorials.
units.literal: On renzi, the winter solstice; the hundred officials submitted congratulatory memorials.

units.zh: 以昭儀侯氏為汧國夫人，昭容夏氏為虢國夫人，昭媛白氏為沛國夫人，出使美宣鄧氏為魏國夫人，禦正楚真張氏為涼國夫人，司簿德美周氏為宋國夫人，侍真吳氏為渤海郡夫人，其餘並封郡夫人。
units.en: Shining Lady Hou became Lady of Qian, Shining Beauty Xia Lady of Guo, Shining Companion Bai Lady of Pei, envoy of fine announcement Deng Lady of Wei, rectifier Chuzhen Zhang Lady of Liang, registrar of virtuous beauty Zhou Lady of Song, attendant of truth Wu Lady of Bohai, and the rest county ladies.
units.literal: Shining Lady Hou was made Lady of Qian, Shining Beauty Xia was made Lady of Guo, Shining Companion Bai was made Lady of Pei, Palace Envoy of Fine Announcement Deng was made Lady of Wei, Imperial Rectifier Chuzhen Zhang was made Lady of Liang, Registrar of Virtuous Beauty Zhou was made Lady of Song, Attendant of Truth Wu was made Lady of Bohai, and the rest were all made ladies of commanderies.

units.zh: 丁巳，河中節度使、守太師、兼尚書令、西平王李繼麟可依前守太師、兼尚書令、河中護國軍節度使、西平王，仍賜鐵券。
units.en: On dingsi Li Jilin of Hezhong—Guardian Grand Preceptor, chancellor, Prince of Xiping—kept those posts as Huguo commissioner and also received an iron tally.
units.literal: On dingsi, Hezhong military commissioner, Guardian Grand Preceptor, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Xiping Li Jilin could remain Guardian Grand Preceptor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, Hezhong Huguo army military commissioner, and Prince of Xiping, and was also granted an iron tally.

units.zh: 戊午，幸李嗣源、李紹榮之第，縱酒作樂。
units.en: On wuwu Cunxu visited Li Siyuan and Li Shaorong and drank with music.
units.literal: On wuwu, the Emperor visited the residences of Li Siyuan and Li Shaorong and drank freely with music.

units.zh: 是日，鎮州地震；
units.en: That day Zhen had an earthquake;
units.literal: That day, Zhen prefecture had an earthquake;

units.zh: 契丹寇蔚州。
units.en: and the Khitan raided Wei.
units.literal: the Khitan raided Wei prefecture.

units.zh: 十二月戊辰，幸西苑校獵。
units.en: In the twelfth month on wuchen Cunxu reviewed the hunt at the Western Park.
units.literal: In the twelfth month on wuchen, the Emperor visited the Western Park to review the hunt.

units.zh: 己巳，詔汴州節度使李嗣源歸鎮。
units.en: On jisi an edict sent Bianzhou commissioner Li Siyuan back to his post.
units.literal: On jisi, an edict ordered Bianzhou military commissioner Li Siyuan to return to his post.

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》作：己巳，命宣武軍節度使李嗣源將宿衛兵三萬七千人赴汴州，遂如幽州禦契丹。）〉
units.en: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》 says on jisi Li Siyuan of Xuanyi was ordered to march thirty-seven thousand palace guards to Bian and then on to Youzhou against the Khitan.)〉
units.literal: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》 reads: On jisi, Xuanyi army military commissioner Li Siyuan was ordered to lead thirty-seven thousand palace guards to Bianzhou and then proceed to Youzhou to repel the Khitan.)〉

units.zh: 庚午，帝與皇后劉氏幸張全義第，酒酣，帝命皇后拜全義為養父，全義惶恐致謝，復出珍貨貢獻。
units.en: On gengwu Cunxu and Empress Liu visited Zhang Quanyi; deep in wine Cunxu made the empress bow to Quanyi as adoptive father; Quanyi trembled, thanked him, and again sent treasures.
units.literal: On gengwu, the Emperor and Empress Liu visited Zhang Quanyi's residence; when the wine was deep the Emperor ordered the empress to bow to Quanyi as adoptive father; Quanyi in fear and trembling thanked him and again presented precious goods in tribute.

units.zh: 翌日，皇后傳制，命學士草謝全義書，學士趙鳳密疏，陳國後無拜人臣為父之禮，帝雖嘉之，竟不能已其事。
units.en: Next day the empress ordered academicians to draft thanks to Quanyi; Zhao Feng secretly argued that a ruler does not bow to a subject as father—Cunxu praised him yet could not stop it.
units.literal: The next day the empress transmitted an order commanding the academicians to draft a letter thanking Quanyi; academician Zhao Feng submitted a secret memorial stating that after becoming ruler there was no rite of bowing to a subject as father; though the Emperor praised it, in the end he could not stop the affair.

units.zh: 壬申，以教坊使王承顏為興州刺史。
units.en: On renshen music-bureau commissioner Wang Chengyan became Xing prefect.
units.literal: On renshen, music-bureau commissioner Wang Chengyan was made Xingzhou prefect.

units.zh: 丙申，詔取來年正月七日幸魏州。
units.en: On bingchen an edict set the seventh of next year's first month for a visit to Wei.
units.literal: On bingchen, an edict set the first day of the first month of next year for a visit to Weizhou.

units.zh: 庚辰，畋於近郊，至夕還宮。
units.en: On gengchen Cunxu hunted near the city and returned at dusk.
units.literal: On gengchen, the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs and returned to the palace at evening.

units.zh: 壬午，契丹寇嵐州。
units.en: On renwu the Khitan raided Lan.
units.literal: On renwu, the Khitan raided Lan prefecture.

units.zh: 党項遣使貢方物。
units.en: The Tangut sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: The Tangut sent envoys with local products.

units.zh: 乙酉，幸龍門佛寺祈雪。
units.en: On yiyou Cunxu visited Longmen temple to pray for snow.
units.literal: On yiyou, the Emperor visited Longmen Buddhist temple to pray for snow.

units.zh: 丙戌，以徐州節度使李紹真為北面行營副招討使。
units.en: On bingxu Li Shaozhen of Xuzhou became northern campaign vice overall commander.
units.literal: On bingxu, Xuzhou military commissioner Li Shaozhen was made northern campaign army vice overall commander.

units.zh: 戊子，李嗣源奏，部署大軍自宣武軍北征。
units.en: On wuzi Li Siyuan reported deploying the main army north from Xuanyi.
units.literal: On wuzi, Li Siyuan memorialized that he had deployed the great army for a northern campaign from Xuanyi.

units.zh: 淮南楊溥遣使貢獻。
units.en: Yang Pu of Huainan sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: Yang Pu of Huainan sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 己丑，幸龍門。
units.en: On jichou Cunxu visited Longmen.
units.literal: On jichou, the Emperor visited Longmen.

units.zh: 庚寅，詔河南尹張全義為洛京留守，判在京諸軍事。
units.en: On gengyin Zhang Quanyi as Henan intendant was made Luoyang residence-regent with command of capital forces.
units.literal: On gengyin, an edict made Henan Intendant Zhang Quanyi Luoyang capital residence-regent and placed him in charge of all military affairs in the capital.

units.zh: 是日，日傍有背氣，凡十二。
units.en: That day twelve solar halos were seen.
units.literal: That day twelve halos appeared beside the sun.

units.zh: 同光三年春正月甲午朔，帝御明堂殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。
units.en: In spring of Tongguang 3, on the jiawu new moon, the Emperor held new-year court in Bright Hall with full guard.
units.literal: Tongguang year 3, spring, first month, jiawu new moon: the Emperor attended Bright Hall for new-year congratulations; guards and escort followed the prescribed form.

units.zh: 丙申，詔以昭宗、少帝山陵未備，宜令有司別選園陵改葬，尋以年饑財匱而止。
units.en: On bingshen an edict ordered new tombs for Zhaozong and the Young Emperor; famine and empty coffers soon stopped the work.
units.literal: On bingshen, an edict: because Emperor Zhaozong and the Young Emperor's mausoleums were not complete, relevant offices should choose new burial mounds for reinterment; soon the plan was halted for famine and depleted funds.

units.zh: 契丹寇幽州。
units.en: The Khitan struck Youzhou.
units.literal: The Khitan raided Youzhou.

units.zh: 戊戌，詔：「起今後特恩授官及侍衛諸軍將校、內諸司等官，其告身官給，舊例朱膠錢、台省禮錢並停，其餘合征台省禮錢，比舊數五分中許征一分，特恩者不征。
units.en: On wuxu an edict said, "Henceforth special appointments and guard or inner-palace officers lose cinnabar-glue and secretariat courtesy fees; where courtesy fees remain, collect only one-fifth of the old rate, and none on special favors.
units.literal: On wuxu, an edict: "From now on, for specially favored appointments and for guard-army officers and inner-palace offices, the commission documents and salary grants formerly charged cinnabar-glue fees and secretariat courtesy fees are all abolished; for other cases where secretariat courtesy fees are due, only one part in five of the old amount may be collected, and none from special favors.

units.zh: 兵、吏部兩司逐月各支錢四十貫文，充吏人食直。
units.en: War and Personnel are each to pay forty strings monthly for clerks' rations.
units.literal: The War and Personnel ministries are each to pay forty strings a month for clerks' board.

units.zh: 少府監鑄錢造印文，今後不得征納銅炭價直，其料物官給。」
units.en: The mint may no longer charge for copper and charcoal; the state supplies materials."
units.literal: The Mint Directorate casting coin and seal inscriptions may no longer collect copper and charcoal charges; materials are to be supplied by the state."

units.zh: 庚子，車駕發京師幸鄴。
units.en: On gengzi the court set out for Ye.
units.literal: On gengzi the imperial carriage left the capital for Ye.

units.zh: 以前許州節度使李紹衝為太子少保；
units.en: Li Shaochong, former Xuzhou commissioner, became Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent;
units.literal: Former Xuzhou military commissioner Li Shaochong was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent;

units.zh: 以前邠州節度使韓恭為右金吾大將軍，充兩街使；
units.en: Han Gong of Binzhou became Right Golden Guard senior general and two-ward commissioner;
units.literal: former Binzhou military commissioner Han Gong was made Right Golden Guard senior general and charged as commissioner of the two wards;

units.zh: 以前安州節度使朱漢賓為左龍武統軍。
units.en: Zhu Hanbin of Anzhou became Left Dragon Martial commander.
units.literal: former Anzhou military commissioner Zhu Hanbin was made Left Dragon Martial commander.

units.zh: 庚戌，車駕至鄴。
units.en: On gengxu the court arrived at Ye.
units.literal: On gengxu the imperial carriage reached Ye.

units.zh: 命青州節度使符習修酸棗河堤。
units.en: Fu Xi of Qing was ordered to repair the Suanzao River dike.
units.literal: Qingzhou military commissioner Fu Xi was ordered to repair the Suanzao River dike.

units.zh: 先是，梁末帝決河隄，引水東注至鄆、濮，以限我軍，至是方修之。
units.en: Liang's last emperor had cut the dike to flood Yan and Pu against our armies; repair began only now.
units.literal: Earlier, the Last Emperor of Liang had breached the dike and diverted the river east toward Yan and Pu to hem in our army; only now was it being repaired.

units.zh: 丙辰，幽州上言，節度使李存賢卒。
units.en: On bingchen Youzhou reported the death of commissioner Li Cunxian.
units.literal: On bingchen Youzhou reported that military commissioner Li Cunxian had died.

units.zh: 二月甲子朔，詔：「興唐府管內有百姓隨絲鹽錢，每兩與減五十文。
units.en: On the jiazi new moon in the second month an edict said, "In Xingtang circuit reduce silk-salt money by fifty cash per liang.
units.literal: Second month, jiazi new moon, an edict: "Within Xingtang prefecture, where the people pay silk-salt money, reduce fifty cash per liang.

units.zh: 逐年所俵蠶鹽，每鬥與減五十文。
units.en: For annual cocoon-salt deliveries, reduce fifty cash per dou.
units.literal: For annual delivered cocoon-salt, reduce fifty cash per dou.

units.zh: 小菉豆稅，每畝與減放三升。
units.en: Remit three sheng of the small mung-bean tax per mu.
units.literal: For the small mung-bean tax, remit three sheng per mu.

units.zh: 都城內所征稅絲，永與除放。」
units.en: The capital silk tax is abolished forever."
units.literal: The silk tax levied within the capital is abolished forever."

units.zh: 丙寅，定州節度使王都來朝。
units.en: On bingyin Wang Du of Ding came to court.
units.literal: On bingyin, Dingzhou military commissioner Wang Du came to court.

units.zh: 丁卯，畋於近郊。
units.en: On dingmao he hunted near the city.
units.literal: On dingmao he hunted in the near suburbs.

units.zh: 己巳，召從臣擊球於鞠場。
units.en: On jisi he summoned ministers for cuju on the ball ground.
units.literal: On jisi he summoned attending ministers to play cuju on the ball ground.

units.zh: 辛未，許州上言：「襄城、葉縣準敕割隸汝州，其扶溝等縣請卻隸當州。」
units.en: On xinwei Xuzhou asked that Fugou and other counties, after Xiangcheng and Ye went to Ru by edict, return to Xuzhou."
units.literal: On xinwei Xuzhou reported: "Xiangcheng and Ye counties were by edict transferred to Ru prefecture; we ask that Fugou and other counties be returned to this prefecture."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was granted.
units.literal: It was followed.

units.zh: 甲戌，以滄州節度使李紹斌為幽州節度使，依前檢校太保；
units.en: On jiaxu Li Shaobin of Cang became Youzhou commissioner, still acting Grand Guardian;
units.literal: On jiaxu, Cangzhou military commissioner Li Shaobin was made Youzhou military commissioner, still acting Grand Guardian;

units.zh: 以大同軍留後安元信為滄州節度使。
units.en: An Yuanxin, Datong acting commissioner, took Cang.
units.literal: Datong army acting commissioner An Yuanxin was made Cangzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 乙亥，幸王莽河射雁。
units.en: On yihai he shot geese at Wangmang River.
units.literal: On yihai he visited Wangmang River to shoot wild geese.

units.zh: 丙子，李嗣源奏，涿州東南殺敗契丹，生擒首領三十人。
units.en: On bingzi Li Siyuan reported defeating the Khitan southeast of Zhuo and capturing thirty leaders.
units.literal: On bingzi Li Siyuan memorialized that southeast of Zhuo prefecture the Khitan had been defeated and thirty leaders taken alive.

units.zh: 符習奏，修堤役夫遇雪寒逃散。
units.en: Fu Xi reported dike workers fleeing the snow and cold.
units.literal: Fu Xi memorialized that dike laborers had scattered in snow and cold.

units.zh: 樞密使郭崇韜上表辭兼鎮。
units.en: Guo Chongtao asked to give up his concurrent command.
units.literal: Chief Palace Secretary Guo Chongtao submitted a memorial declining the concurrent prefecture.

units.zh: 時帝命李紹斌鎮幽州，以其時望未重，欲以李嗣源為鎮帥，且為紹斌聲援，移郭崇韜兼領汴州。
units.en: Shaobin's standing at Youzhou was still light, so the throne wanted Li Siyuan as backing and moved Guo Chongtao to concurrent Bian.
units.literal: The Emperor had ordered Li Shaobin to hold Youzhou; because his standing was not yet weighty, he wished Li Siyuan as military commander to support Shaobin and shifted Guo Chongtao to hold Bianzhou concurrently.

units.zh: 召崇韜議之，崇韜奏以為當，因懇辭兼領。
units.en: Chongtao was summoned, approved the plan, and begged off the concurrent post.
units.literal: Chongtao was summoned to discuss it; he said the plan was right and earnestly declined the concurrent post.

units.zh: 庚辰，以宣武軍節度使李嗣源為鎮州節度使。
units.en: On gengchen Li Siyuan of Xuanyi became Zhen commissioner.
units.literal: On gengchen, Xuanyi army military commissioner Li Siyuan was made Zhenzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 辛巳，以皇子繼潼、繼嵩、繼蟾、繼嶢並檢校司徒，皆衝幼，未出閣。
units.en: On xinsi the infant princes Jitong, Jisong, Jichan, and Jiyao were made acting Secretariat Directors, none yet out of the palace.
units.literal: On xinsi the princes Jitong, Jisong, Jichan, and Jiyao were all made acting Secretariat Directors; all were infants and had not left the palace.

units.zh: 突厥、渤海國皆遣使貢方物。
units.en: Tujue and Parhae both sent tribute.
units.literal: Tujue and Parhae both sent envoys with local products.

units.zh: 帝幸近郊射雁。
units.en: The Emperor hunted geese in the suburbs.
units.literal: The Emperor visited the near suburbs to shoot wild geese.

units.zh: 甲申，以樞密使郭崇韜為依前守侍中、監修國史、兼樞密使，加食邑實封。
units.en: On jiashen Guo Chongtao kept Palace Attendant, national-history director, and chief secretary, with added fief and seal.
units.literal: On jiashen, Chief Palace Secretary Guo Chongtao remained acting Palace Attendant, director of compiling the national history, and concurrent chief secretary, with added fief income and enfeoffment.

units.zh: 廣南劉岩遣使奉書於帝，稱「大漢國王致書上大唐皇帝」。
units.en: Liu Yan of the south sent a letter opening, "The King of Great Han to the Emperor of Great Tang."
units.literal: Liu Yan of Guangnan sent envoys with a letter to the Emperor reading, "The King of Great Han writes to the Emperor of Great Tang."

units.zh: 乙酉，帝射鴨於郭泊。
units.en: On yiyou he shot ducks at Guo Marsh.
units.literal: On yiyou the Emperor shot ducks at Guo Marsh.

units.zh: 丙戌，定州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中王都進封開國公，加食邑實封。
units.en: On bingxu Wang Du of Ding—acting Grand Commandant and Palace Attendant—was made Duke Who Opens the State with added fief.
units.literal: On bingxu, Dingzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Commandant, and concurrent Palace Attendant Wang Du was advanced to Duke Who Opens the State, with added fief income and enfeoffment.

units.zh: 戊子，幸近郊射雁。
units.en: On wuzi he again hunted geese in the suburbs.
units.literal: On wuzi he visited the near suburbs to shoot wild geese.

units.zh: 工部尚書崔柅卒，贈右僕射。
units.en: Cui Ni of Works died and was posthumously made Right Vice Director.
units.literal: Minister of Works Cui Ni died and was posthumously made Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 三月癸巳朔，賜扈從諸軍將士優給，自二十千至一千。
units.en: On the guisi new moon escort troops received bonuses from twenty thousand down to one thousand.
units.literal: Third month, guisi new moon: the escort armies were given extra grants from twenty thousand down to one thousand.

units.zh: 甲午，振武軍節度使、洛京內外蕃漢馬步使朱守殷奏，昨修月陂堤，至德宮南獲玉璽一紐，獻之。
units.en: On jiawu Zhu Shouyin of Zhenwu reported finding a jade seal while repairing the Moon Mound dike south of Zhide Palace and presented it.
units.literal: On jiawu, Zhenwu military commissioner and Luoyang inner-and-outer Han-and-barbarian horse-and-foot commissioner Zhu Shouyin memorialized that while repairing the Moon Mound dike south of Zhide Palace he had found one jade seal and presented it.

units.zh: 詔示百官，驗其文，曰「皇帝行寶」 四字，方圓八寸，厚二寸，背紐交龍，光瑩精妙。
units.en: The court displayed it; the inscription read "Emperor's traveling treasure," eight by two cun, crossed-dragon knob, bright and fine.
units.literal: An edict showed it to the hundred officials; examining the inscription, it bore the four characters "Emperor's traveling treasure," eight cun square and two cun thick, with a crossed-dragon knob on the back, lustrous and exquisite.

units.zh: 守殷又於役所得古文錢四百六十六，內二十六文曰「得一元寶」，四百四十曰「順天元寶」，上之。
units.en: Shouyin also turned up 466 antique coins—26 "De yi yuan bao" and 440 "Shun tian yuan bao."
units.literal: Shouyin also found four hundred sixty-six antique coins in the labor: twenty-six reading "De yi yuan bao" and four hundred forty reading "Shun tian yuan bao," and presented them.

units.zh: 〈（龐元英《文昌雜錄》云：同光三年，洛京積善坊得古文錢，曰「得一元寶」，「順天元寶」，史不載何代鑄錢。
units.en: (Pang Yuanying's 《Wenchang Miscellany》 says Tongguang 3 coins from Jishan ward read "De yi yuan bao" and "Shun tian yuan bao," with no dynasty named in the annals.
units.literal: (Pang Yuanying's 《Miscellany from Wenchang》 says: In Tongguang 3, Jishan ward in Luoyang yielded antique coins reading "De yi yuan bao" and "Shun tian yuan bao"; the history does not record which age cast them.

units.zh: 近見錢氏《錢譜》云：史思明再陷洛陽，鑄「得一錢」，賊黨以為「得一」非佳號，乃改「順天」。
units.en: The Qian 《Coin Canon》 says Shi Siming cast "De yi" at Luoyang, then renamed it "Shun tian" as a bad omen.
units.literal: Recently the Qian clan's 《Coin Canon》 says: when Shi Siming again took Luoyang he cast "De yi" coin; the rebels thought "de yi" an ill omen and changed it to "Shun tian."

units.zh: 蓋史思明所鑄錢也。）〉
units.en: They were Shi Siming's coinage.)〉
units.literal: These were coins cast by Shi Siming.)〉

units.zh: 丙子，寒食節，帝與皇后出近郊，遙饗代州親廟。
units.en: On bingzi, Cold Food, the Emperor and Empress went to the suburbs and offered remotely to the Dai ancestral temple.
units.literal: On bingzi, Cold Food Festival, the Emperor and Empress went to the near suburbs and made a distant offering to the ancestral temple at Dai prefecture.

units.zh: 庚子，詔取三月十七日車駕歸洛京。
units.en: On gengzi an edict set the seventeenth of the third month for return to Luoyang.
units.literal: On gengzi an edict fixed the seventeenth day of the third month for the imperial carriage to return to Luoyang.

units.zh: 壬寅，符習奏，修河堤畢功。
units.en: On renyin Fu Xi reported the dike finished.
units.literal: On renyin Fu Xi memorialized that dike repair was complete.

units.zh: 戊申，帝召郭崇韜謂曰：「朕思在德勝寨時，霍彥威、段凝皆予之敵。
units.en: On wushen the Emperor told Guo Chongtao, "I remember Desheng stockade, when Huo Yanwei and Duan Ning were my enemies.
units.literal: On wushen the Emperor summoned Guo Chongtao and said: "I think of our days at Desheng stockade, when Huo Yanwei and Duan Ning were both my foes.

units.zh: 終日格鬥，戰聲相聞，安知二年之間，在吾廡下。
units.en: We fought all day within earshot—who imagined that in two years they would serve under my roof?
units.literal: All day we grappled and battle cries rang unceasing—who could know that within two years they would stand beneath my eaves?

units.zh: 吾無少康、光武之才，一旦重興基構者，良由二三勳德同心輔翼故也。
units.en: I am no Shaokang or Guangwu; the realm rose again only because a few ministers stood together.
units.literal: I lack the talent of Shaokang or Guangwu; that the foundation could suddenly rise again was truly because two or three meritorious ministers aided in one heart.

units.zh: 朕有時夢寢，如在戚城，思念曩時挑戰鏖兵，勞則勞矣，然而揚旌伐鼓，差慰人心，殘壘荒溝，依然在目。
units.en: In dream I am back at Qi, remembering the old battles—grueling, yet drums and banners still heartened men; ruined walls and empty trenches still stand in view.
units.literal: Sometimes waking or sleeping I seem to be at Qi city, recalling the old challenges and fierce battles—hard labor, yet raising banners and beating drums still somewhat comforted the heart; ruined ramparts and desolate ditches still lie before the eyes.

units.zh: 予欲按德勝故寨，與卿再陳舊事。」
units.en: I want to walk the old Desheng camp and tell the tale again with you."
units.literal: I wish to visit the old Desheng stockade and recount the past with you."

units.zh: 崇韜曰：「此去澶州不遠，陛下再觀戰地，益知王業之艱難，豈不韙哉！」
units.en: Chongtao said, "Chanzhou is near; seeing the field again would teach how hard the throne is won—is that not wise?"
units.literal: Chongtao said: "It is not far to Chanzhou; if Your Majesty views the battlefield again you will better know how hard kingship is—is that not excellent?"

units.zh: 己酉，車駕發鄴宮。
units.en: On jiyou the court left Ye.
units.literal: On jiyou the imperial carriage left the Ye palace.

units.zh: 辛亥，至德勝城。
units.en: On xinhai it reached Desheng.
units.literal: On xinhai it reached Desheng city.

units.zh: 登城四望，指戰陣之處以諭宰臣。
units.en: He climbed the wall, looked about, and pointed out the old battle lines to his ministers.
units.literal: He climbed the wall and looked about on four sides, pointing out where the battle lines had stood to instruct the chief ministers.

units.zh: 渡河南觀廢柵舊址，至楊村寨，沿河至戚城，置酒作樂而罷。
units.en: South of the river he traced ruined camps to Yang village and Qi, feasted, and turned back.
units.literal: Crossing the river south he viewed the ruined stockade sites, reached Yang village stockade, followed the river to Qi city, set out wine and music, then stopped.

units.zh: 壬子，淮南楊溥遣使朝貢。
units.en: On renzi Yang Pu of Huainan sent tribute.
units.literal: On renzi Yang Pu of Huainan sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 東京副留守張憲奏，諸營家口一千二百人逃亡，以艱食故也。
units.en: Zhang Xian of the Eastern Capital reported 1,200 camp dependents fleeing for hunger.
units.literal: Eastern Capital deputy residence-regent Zhang Xian memorialized that twelve hundred dependents of the camps had fled for lack of food.

units.zh: 時宮苑使王允平、伶人景進為帝廣采宮人，不擇良家委巷，殆千餘人，車駕不給，載以牛車，累累於路焉。
units.en: Wang Yunping and the actor Jing Jin swept up nearly a thousand palace women from every alley; ox carts lined the road for lack of transport.
units.literal: At that time Palace Parks Commissioner Wang Yunping and actor Jing Jin broadly gathered palace women for the Emperor without choosing respectable households or lanes—nearly a thousand persons; the imperial train could not supply them, and they were loaded on ox carts, strung out along the road.

units.zh: 庚辰，車駕至自鄴。
units.en: On gengchen the court returned from Ye.
units.literal: On gengchen the imperial carriage returned from Ye.

units.zh: 辛酉，詔本朝以雍州為西京，洛州為東都，并州為北都。
units.en: On xinyou an edict said, Yong is Western Capital, Luo Eastern Capital, and Bing Northern Capital.
units.literal: On xinyou an edict: This dynasty takes Yong prefecture as Western Capital, Luo as Eastern Capital, and Bing as Northern Capital.

units.zh: 近以魏州為東京，宜依舊以洛京為東都，魏州改為鄴都，與北都並為次府。
units.en: Weizhou had lately been Eastern Capital; Luoyang should again be Eastern Capital, Weizhou renamed Ye Capital, and Ye ranked with Bing as a secondary seat.
units.literal: Recently Weizhou was made Eastern Capital; it is proper to restore Luoyang as Eastern Capital, change Weizhou to Ye Capital, and rank it with the Northern Capital as a secondary metropolis.

units.zh: 夏四月癸亥朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: On the guihai new moon in the fourth month the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, guihai new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 以租庸副使孔循權知汴州軍州事。
units.en: Kong Xun, rent-and-corvée vice commissioner, took acting Bian.
units.literal: Rent-and-corvée vice commissioner Kong Xun was made acting Bianzhou military and civil commissioner.

units.zh: 丙寅，淮南楊溥遣使貢方物。
units.en: On bingyin Yang Pu sent tribute goods.
units.literal: On bingyin Yang Pu of Huainan sent envoys with local products.

units.zh: 壬申，幸甘泉亭。
units.en: On renshen he visited Sweet Spring Pavilion.
units.literal: On renshen he visited Sweet Spring Pavilion.

units.zh: 癸酉，詔翰林學士承旨盧質覆試新及第進士。
units.en: On guiyou Lu Zhi of Hanlin was ordered to re-test the new jinshi.
units.literal: On guiyou an edict ordered Hanlin Academician Expositor Lu Zhi to re-examine the newly passed metropolitan graduates.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：時以新及第進士符蒙正等尚幹浮議，故命盧質覆試。）〉
units.en: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutes》 says Fu Mengzheng and others still seemed shallow, so Lu Zhi re-tested them.)〉
units.literal: (The 《Institutes of the Five Dynasties》: because the new graduates including Fu Mengzheng still drew empty talk, Lu Zhi was ordered to re-examine them.)〉

units.zh: 租庸使奏：「時雨久愆，請下諸道州府，依法祈禱。」
units.en: "The rent commissioner asked that every circuit and prefecture pray for rain by law."
units.literal: The rent-and-corvée commissioner memorialized: "Rain has long been delayed; we ask that all circuits and prefectures pray by law."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was granted.
units.literal: It was followed.

units.zh: 乙亥，帝與皇后幸郭崇韜第，又幸左龍武統軍朱漢賓之第。
units.en: On yihai the Emperor and Empress visited Guo Chongtao, then Zhu Hanbin.
units.literal: On yihai the Emperor and Empress visited Guo Chongtao's residence, then visited Left Dragon Martial commander Zhu Hanbin's residence.

units.zh: 戊寅，以耀州為團練州，其順義軍額宜停。
units.en: On wuyin Yao became a training prefecture and the Shunyi army title ended.
units.literal: On wuyin Yao prefecture was made a training prefecture and the Shunyi army title was abolished.

units.zh: 庚辰，帝侍皇太后幸會節園，遂幸李紹榮之第。
units.en: On gengchen he escorted the Empress Dowager to Festival Garden, then visited Li Shaorong.
units.literal: On gengchen the Emperor attended the Empress Dowager at Festival Garden, then visited Li Shaorong's residence.

units.zh: 辛巳，以旱甚，詔河南府徙市，造五方龍，集巫禱祭。
units.en: On xinsi, in severe drought, Henan was told to shift the market, fashion five dragons, and gather shamans.
units.literal: On xinsi, because drought was severe, an edict ordered Henan prefecture to move the market, make five-direction dragons, and gather shamans for prayer.

units.zh: 癸未，以兗州節度使李紹欽為鄧州節度使。
units.en: On guiwei Li Shaoqin of Yan became Deng commissioner.
units.literal: On guiwei Yanzhou military commissioner Li Shaoqin was made Dengzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 丁亥，以鎮州節度使李嗣源兼北面水陸轉運使，以徐州節度使李紹真為副。
units.en: On dinghai Li Siyuan of Zhen took northern transport with Li Shaozhen of Xuzhou as deputy.
units.literal: On dinghai Zhenzhou military commissioner Li Siyuan was made concurrent northern land-and-water transport commissioner, with Xuzhou military commissioner Li Shaozhen as deputy.

units.zh: 禮部貢院新及第進士四人，其王澈改為第一，桑維翰第二，符蒙正第三，成僚第四。
units.en: Four new jinshi were re-ranked: Wang Che first, Sang Weihan second, Fu Mengzheng third, Cheng Liao fourth.
units.literal: The Ministry of Rites examination yard had four new graduates: Wang Che was changed to first place, Sang Weihan second, Fu Mengzheng third, and Cheng Liao fourth.

units.zh: 禮部侍郎裴皞既無黜落，特議寬容。
units.en: Pei Hao of Rites had failed none and was treated leniently.
units.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Pei Hao had dismissed none and was specially treated with leniency.

units.zh: 今後新及第人，候過堂日委中書門下精加詳覆。
units.en: Henceforth new jinshi must pass a careful Secretariat review on court-audience day.
units.literal: Henceforth new graduates, when the court-audience day arrives, are to be carefully re-examined by the Secretariat and Chancellery.

units.zh: 陝州奏，木連理。
units.en: Shan reported conjoined trees.
units.literal: Shan prefecture reported trees growing with conjoined trunks.

units.zh: 庚寅，中書侍郎兼工部尚書、平章事趙光胤卒，廢朝三日。
