units.en: On gengyin Zhao Guangyin, Secretariat vice director and chief minister, died; court mourned three days.
units.literal: On gengyin, Secretariat Vice Director, concurrent Minister of Works, and co-equal chief minister Zhao Guangyin died; court was suspended three days.

units.zh: 五月壬辰朔，淮南楊溥貢端午節物。
units.en: On the renchen new moon in the fifth month Yang Pu of Huainan sent Dragon Boat Festival gifts.
units.literal: Fifth month, renchen new moon: Yang Pu of Huainan presented Dragon Boat Festival gifts.

units.zh: 丁酉，皇太妃劉氏薨於晉陽，廢朝五日，帝於興安殿行服。
units.en: On dingyou Grand Imperial Consort Liu died at Jinyang; court mourned five days while the Emperor observed mourning at Xing’an Hall.
units.literal: On dingyou Grand Imperial Consort Liu died at Jinyang; court was suspended five days; the Emperor observed mourning at Xing’an Hall.

units.zh: 時皇太后欲奔喪於晉陽，百官上表請留，乃止。
units.en: The Empress Dowager then wished to rush to Jinyang for the mourning; officials memorialized asking her to stay, and she desisted.
units.literal: At that time the Empress Dowager wished to rush to Jinyang for the mourning; the hundred officials memorialized asking her to stay, and she desisted.

units.zh: 戊戌，以鎮州行軍司馬、知軍府事任圜為工部尚書。
units.en: On wuxu Ren Huan, Zhenzhou campaign marshal and military overseer, became Minister of Works.
units.literal: On wuxu Zhenzhou campaign army marshal and military government overseer Ren Huan was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 戊申，幸龍門廣化寺祈雨。
units.en: On wushen Cunxu visited Longmen Guanghua Temple to pray for rain.
units.literal: On wushen the Emperor visited Longmen Guanghua Temple to pray for rain.

units.zh: 己酉，黑水、女真皆遣使朝貢。
units.en: On jiyou Heishui and the Jurchen both sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: On jiyou Heishui and the Jurchen both sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 戊午，以鳳州衙內馬步軍都指揮使李繼昶為涇州節度使、檢校太傅。
units.en: On wuwu Li Jichang, Fengzhou yamen horse-and-foot commander, became Jingzhou commissioner and acting Grand Tutor.
units.literal: On wuwu Fengzhou yamen horse-and-foot commander Li Jichang was made Jingzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 己未，詔天下見禁罪人，如無大過，速令疏放。
units.en: On jiwei an edict ordered imprisoned convicts empire-wide, if guilty of no grave offense, promptly released.
units.literal: On jiwei an edict ordered that imprisoned convicts throughout the realm, if guilty of no great offense, be promptly released.

units.zh: 幸玄元宮禱雨。
units.en: Cunxu visited the Mysterious Origin palace to pray for rain.
units.literal: The Emperor visited the Mysterious Origin palace to pray for rain.

units.zh: 六月癸亥，雲州上言，去年契丹從磧北歸帳，達靼因相掩擊，其首領於越族帳自磧北以部族羊馬三萬來降，已到南界，今差使人來赴闕奏事。
units.en: On guihai in the sixth month Yun reported that after the Khitan returned north, Tatars fought; Chief Yuyue brought 30,000 head of tribe, sheep, and horse to the border and sent envoys to court.
units.literal: Sixth month, guihai: Yun prefecture reported that last year, when the Khitan returned from north of the desert to their tents, the Tatars attacked one another; the chief Yuyue's clan brought tribes, sheep, and horses numbering thirty thousand to submit from north of the desert, had reached the southern frontier, and now sent envoys to court to report.

units.zh: 甲子，太白晝見。
units.en: On jiazi Venus shone by day.
units.literal: On jiazi Venus appeared in daylight.

units.zh: 丁卯，以滄州節度使安元信充北面行營馬步軍都排陣使。
units.en: On dingmao An Yuanxin, military governor of Cang Prefecture, was made horse-and-foot array marshal of the northern campaign army.
units.literal: On dingmao, Cangzhou military commissioner An Yuanxin was made northern campaign army horse-and-foot array marshal.

units.zh: 辛未，以宗正卿李紓充昭宗、少帝改卜園陵使。
units.en: On xinwei Li Shu of the Imperial Clan was made mausoleum-relocation commissioner for Zhaozong and the Young Emperor.
units.literal: On xinwei Director of the Imperial Clan Li Shu was made commissioner for relocating the mausoleums of Zhaozong and the Young Emperor.

units.zh: 壬申，京師雨足。
units.en: On renshen the capital had enough rain.
units.literal: On renshen the capital had sufficient rain.

units.zh: 自是大雨，至於九月，晝夜陰晦，未嘗澄霽，江河漂溢，堤防壞決，天下皆訴水災。
units.en: Then floods ran until the ninth month—endless gloom, rivers bursting dikes, and flood cries everywhere.
units.literal: From then great rain fell until the ninth month; day and night were overcast and never cleared; rivers overflowed and dikes burst; the realm all cried flood disaster.

units.zh: 丁丑，詔吳越王錢鏐將行冊禮，準禮文合用竹冊，宜令所司修製玉冊。
units.en: On dingchou an edict ordered jade tablets instead of bamboo for Qian Liu's Wu-Yue enfeoffment rites.
units.literal: On dingchou an edict: when King Qian Liu of Wu-Yue was to undergo enfeoffment rites, the ritual texts called for bamboo tablets; the responsible offices should instead prepare jade tablets.

units.zh: 時郭崇韜秉政，以為不可，樞密承旨段徊讚其事，故有是命。
units.en: Guo Chongtao opposed it, but expositor Duan Hui urged it, and the order stood.
units.literal: Guo Chongtao then held power and thought it improper; Chief Secretary expositor Duan Hui praised the affair, hence the order.

units.zh: 癸丑，以天德軍節度使、管內蕃漢都知兵馬使劉承訓為天德軍節度觀察留後。
units.en: On guichou Liu Chengchun of Tiande became acting Tiande commissioner.
units.literal: On guichou, Tiande army military commissioner and circuit-wide Han-and-barbarian commander Liu Chengchun was made Tiande military and surveillance acting commissioner.

units.zh: 丙戌，詔曰：「關內諸陵，頃因喪亂，例遭穿穴，多未掩修。
units.en: On bingxu an edict said, "Pass tombs, robbed in the troubles, lie open and unrepaired.
units.literal: On bingxu, an edict said: "The tombs within the passes, in recent disorder, have commonly been tunneled and many are not yet repaired.

units.zh: 其下宮殿宇法物等，各令奉陵州府據所管陵園修製，仍四時各依舊例薦饗。
units.en: Palaces, halls, and ritual goods are to be restored by tomb-keeping prefectures with seasonal rites as before.
units.literal: Underground palaces, halls, ritual objects, and the like are each to be restored by the tomb-keeping prefectures according to the tombs they oversee, with seasonal offerings as of old.

units.zh: 每陵仰差近陵百姓二十戶充陵戶，以備灑掃。
units.en: Each tomb gets twenty nearby households as tomb keepers for sweeping.
units.literal: For each tomb twenty households of nearby people are to be assigned as tomb households for sweeping.

units.zh: 其壽陵等一十陵，亦一例修掩，量置陵戶。」
units.en: Ten tombs including Shouling are likewise to be covered and staffed."
units.literal: The ten tombs including Shouling are likewise to be repaired and covered, with tomb households set as needed."

units.zh: 戊子，以刑部尚書李琪充昭宗、少帝改卜園陵禮儀使。
units.en: On wuzi Li Qi of Punishments was made ritual commissioner for Zhaozong and the Young Emperor's tombs.
units.literal: On wuzi, Minister of Punishments Li Qi was made ritual commissioner for relocating the mausoleums of Zhaozong and the Young Emperor.

units.zh: 己丑，以工部郎中李途為京兆少尹，充修奉諸陵使。
units.en: On jichou Li Tu of Works became Jingzhao junior intendant and tomb-repair commissioner.
units.literal: On jichou, Works section director Li Tu was made Jingzhao junior intendant and charged as commissioner for repairing and maintaining the tombs.

units.zh: 辛卯，詔括天下私馬，
units.en: On xinmao an edict ordered private horses seized empire-wide,
units.literal: On xinmao, an edict ordered the seizure of private horses throughout the realm,

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：詔下河南、河北諸州，和市戰馬，官吏除一匹外，匿者坐罪。）〉
units.en: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutes》 says Henan and Hebei were to buy war horses; officials kept one each, and hiding horses was a crime.)〉
units.literal: (The 《Institutes of the Five Dynasties》: the edict went to Henan and Hebei prefectures to purchase war horses; officials might keep one each, and concealment was punishable.)〉

units.zh: 將收蜀故也。
units.en: The levy aimed at conquering Shu.
units.literal: This was to prepare for taking Shu.

units.zh: 〈（《三楚新錄》：莊宗謂高季興曰：「今天下負固不服者，惟吳、蜀耳。
units.en: (The 《New Record of the Three Chu》 says Zhuangzong told Gao Jixing, "Only Wu and Shu still defy us.
units.literal: (The 《New Record of the Three Chu》 says: Zhuangzong said to Gao Jixing, "Today those who still hold out against us are only Wu and Shu.

units.zh: 朕欲先有事於蜀，而蜀地險阻尤難，江南才隔荊南一水，朕欲先之，卿以為何如？」
units.en: I would hit Shu first, though its passes are hardest; south of the Yangtze is only a river beyond Jingnan—should I strike Wu instead? What say you?"
units.literal: I wish to strike Shu first, yet Shu's terrain is especially hard; south of the Yangtze is only one river beyond Jingnan—should I strike there first? What do you think?"

units.zh: 季興對曰：「臣聞蜀地富民饒，獲之可建大利；
units.en: Jixing answered, "Shu is rich; its capture would bring great gain;
units.literal: Jixing replied: "I have heard Shu's land is rich and its people prosperous; taking it could build great profit;

units.zh: 江南國貧，地狹民少，得之恐無益。
units.en: Wu is poor, narrow, and thin—little profit there.
units.literal: the southern state is poor, its land narrow and its people few—gaining it would likely bring no benefit.

units.zh: 臣願陛下釋吳先蜀。」
units.en: I beg Your Majesty to leave Wu and take Shu first."
units.literal: I beg Your Majesty to set Wu aside and take Shu first."

units.zh: 時莊宗意亦欲伐蜀，及聞季興之言，果大悅。）〉
units.en: Zhuangzong already favored Shu; Jixing's counsel delighted him.)〉
units.literal: At that time Zhuangzong also wished to attack Shu; hearing Jixing's words, he was greatly pleased.)〉
